hints.title: Even Sum Parity
hints.text: If finalSum is odd, it is impossible to represent it as a sum of even integers, so return an empty list.

hints.title: Greedy Smallest Evens
hints.text: To maximize the number of terms, greedily pick the smallest distinct positive even integers starting from 2, 4, 6, and so on.

hints.title: Absorb Remainder
hints.text: When the remaining sum is smaller than the next even integer, add the remainder to the last collected integer.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumEvenSplit(self, finalSum: int) -> List[int]:
        if finalSum % 2 != 0:
            return []
        res = []
        cur = 2
        while finalSum >= cur:
            res.append(cur)
            finalSum -= cur
            cur += 2
        res[-1] += finalSum
        return res
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all partitions takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy selection of consecutive evens achieves maximum term count in O(sqrt(N)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Odd check followed by greedy accumulation and remainder absorption.
